args.title: Enhance parseAmount to remove Indian rupee and other currency symbols
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update the parseAmount function to remove additional currency symbols including the Indian rupee sign (₹) and currency codes like CHF, ensuring proper parsing of amounts with these signs.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/util/money.ts is responsible for parsing amount strings, but the current parseAmount function only removes a small set of currency symbols. Based on the evidence, it needs enhancement to also remove the Indian rupee sign (₹) and other currency codes like CHF to correctly parse such amounts.
